arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the remaining rows in the failed_jobs table to identify the root cause of job failures and take corrective actions. Remove the backlog by resolving the issues causing the failures.
arguments.summary: Investigated several common causes of 502 errors but found that the actual issue was due to the ingress idle timeout. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing. Exported the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Removed 47 malformed rows from the failed_jobs table which unblocked the retry queue. Next steps are to analyze the remaining rows in the failed_jobs table to identify the root cause of job failures.
